entities.name: Nikolaï Ouchikov
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nikolay Uchikov is a Bulgarian former professional volleyball player. With his club Trentino Diatec he competed at the 2012 FIVB Volleyball Men's Club World Championship. He was part of the Bulgaria men's national volleyball team.
